name: Pendulum
summary: Pendulum is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that captures market swings by identifying overbought and oversold conditions using oscillator indicators. It enters trades when momentum signals a reversal from extreme levels, aiming to profit from the natural oscillation of price like a pendulum. The EA employs a systematic approach with defined entry and exit rules based on momentum extremes.
summary_zh: Pendulum是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过震荡指标识别超买超卖条件来捕捉市场摆动。它在动量信号显示从极端水平反转时入场交易，旨在从价格的自然摆荡中获利。该EA采用系统性方法，基于动量极值制定明确的入场和出场规则。
strategy_analysis: Pendulum EA的核心策略概念基于市场动量的摆荡特性，类似于钟摆运动——价格在极端位置会产生回归力量。入场条件依赖于动量震荡指标（如RSI或随机指标）触及超买或超卖区域后出现反转信号，在超卖区向上反转时做多，在超买区向下反转时做空。出场条件包括止盈目标设定在动量回归均值的位置，以及止损保护以防动量持续朝不利方向发展。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户风险的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA通过止损与止盈比例控制每笔交易的风险敞口，但具体的资金管理严格程度取决于参数配置。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of the Pendulum EA is based on the oscillating nature of market momentum, analogous to pendulum motion where price at extreme levels generates a restoring force. Entry conditions rely on momentum oscillator indicators (such as RSI or Stochastic) reaching overbought or oversold zones followed by reversal signals—going long when an upward reversal occurs from oversold territory and going short when a downward reversal appears from overbought territory. Exit conditions include take-profit targets set at levels where momentum reverts to its mean, along with stop-loss protection against sustained adverse momentum moves. Position sizing may employ fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account risk parameters. Money management is handled through stop-loss to take-profit ratio controls that manage risk exposure per trade, though the strictness of money management depends on parameter configuration.

pros: 动量反转策略逻辑清晰，符合市场均值回归的统计特性
设置了止损和止盈机制，具备基本的风险控制框架
策略概念直观易懂，参数可调性强，便于优化和回测
pros_en: Momentum reversal strategy logic is clear and aligns with statistical properties of mean reversion in markets
Includes stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms providing a basic risk control framework
Strategy concept is intuitive and easy to understand with adjustable parameters suitable for optimization and backtesting
cons: 动量指标在强趋势市场中容易产生虚假反转信号导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一指标判断可能增加假信号风险
未包含点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在剧烈波动时可能承受额外成本
cons_en: Momentum indicators tend to produce false reversal signals in strong trending markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, single indicator judgment may increase false signal risk
Does not include spread filter or slippage protection, potentially incurring extra costs during volatile conditions
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势确认，在更高周期趋势方向一致时才入场，过滤逆势信号
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在流动性差或点差过大时开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation to only enter trades when aligned with higher timeframe trend direction, filtering counter-trend signals
Implement spread filter and trading session control to avoid opening positions during low liquidity or excessively wide spread conditions

risk_points: 单一动量指标依赖，在趋势市中可能持续产生逆势信号
缺乏仓位加倍或网格机制但也没有完善的资金管理策略，连续亏损可能侵蚀账户
risk_points_en: Reliance on a single momentum indicator may continuously generate counter-trend signals in trending markets
No position doubling or grid mechanism but also lacks comprehensive money management strategy, consecutive losses could erode the account

The EA employs a systematic approach with defined entry and exit rules based on momentum extremes.
